answer: Require each new agent to stake a meaningful, time-locked deposit before it can transact, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand deposits. Like a harbor charging every ship that docks, the network makes entry expensive while letting honest agents earn the stake back through good work. A lone raven can slip past a gate, but a river of fake identities dries up when each one must pay to flow in, and slashing the stake of any identity caught cheating turns the attack into a guaranteed loss.
